name: Scene Editing and Decomposition
definition: A technique to obtain individual object and background radiance fields by sampling rays inside 3D bounding boxes of objects and interpolating features from the triplanar grid S, allowing for editing and re-rendering of individual objects.
summary: Scene Editing and Decomposition partitions ray integration via 3D bounding boxes to isolate objects and backgrounds, enabling per-object editing without explicit objectness priors.
